name: Beauty Studio Management System in Excel – Profit per Chair Hour
html:
See which services really earn money per hour of chair time, how many no-shows are costing you and which clients are about to drift away – before you reprice the menu or rent out the next chair. This is a complete back office for a small lash, brow, nail or skin-care studio in Excel: eight connected workbooks that already work with sample data, so you see every alert and dashboard before you type your first client.

Built for owner-technicians with a few technicians, employees and booth renters, and a front-desk coordinator, running a studio of one to five chairs.

What you get:

  • 8 connected workbooks: service menu, pricing and margins; appointment book and chair capacity; clients, consent and patch tests; rebooking, referrals and reviews; memberships, packages and gift cards; technician pay and productivity; stock, back-bar and hygiene logs; takings, profit, cash and growth
  • 552 ready pages: dashboards, calculators, printable forms and checklists, and ready WhatsApp messages
  • 15 languages, each as a blank template, with filled sample-data copies in English
  • Standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice – no macros, no subscription

How it works: 1) open the workbook in your language, 2) type your services, bookings, clients, sales and stock in the yellow cells, 3) margins, free chair hours, due fills, balances owed, pay and profit per service update by themselves. Check your local rules. One payment, instant download.

What it does for you

  • Price every service so each hour of a chair earns your target margin
  • See the cost of a service from product, time and technician pay
  • Fill your book and see the free chair hours you can still sell
  • Cut no-shows with deposits, reminders and a waiting list
  • Keep every client record ready with consent and patch test checklists
  • Know who is due for a fill or infill and message them in one tap
  • Turn happy clients into referrals and reviews, and win back lapsed ones
  • Track every pack, membership and gift card balance and its expiry
  • Pay commission, hourly staff and booth rent right, and see who produces
  • Never run out of back-bar and retail stock, and see cost per service
  • Keep hygiene logs and cleaning checklists up to date for every shift
  • Close the till daily and see profit per service, technician and month

Do I need special software?
No. The files are standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice, which is free.

Does it fit a small studio and a larger one?
Yes. It works for a solo owner-technician and for a studio with several technicians; the sample data shows an owner-technician, two employee technicians, two booth renters, a front-desk coordinator, 4 chairs and a treatment room, 20 services, about 1,650 clients and about 650 appointments a month.

Can I replace the sample data with my own?
Yes. Every workbook comes in 15 languages as a blank template, plus filled sample-data copies in English, so you can explore first and start clean when you are ready. Each fact is typed once and every dashboard reads it from there.

Can I use my own currency, prices and targets?
Yes. Currency, service prices and minutes, margin targets, deposit rules, commission rates, booth rent, reorder points and tax rate are on the settings and list sheets, and every formula follows your changes.

Where do I start?
Start with Part 1 for the service menu and margins, or with the part that hurts most today, such as no-shows or prepaid balances. Each workbook works alone and links to the others as you fill it.

Are there macros or a subscription, and how do I receive it?
No macros and no subscription. You pay once and download a ZIP at once with every workbook in all 15 languages. Hygiene, licensing and consent content is generic, so check your own local rules.
